title: LoRaWAN WoT Binding Form
description: Validation rules for the LoRaWAN binding terms used on an event form within a Thing Description. A form says how a value is carried in the uplink; what the decoded value means (its type, unit, range and enumeration) belongs to the event's 'data' schema and is not described here.

op.description: Uplinks are pushed by the device on its own schedule and cannot be polled, so a LoRaWAN form only ever offers the event subscription operations.

lorav:wireType.description: Data type of the value on the wire, as an xsd:* alias or a native MultiTech type. The value 'number' marks a derived value, which occupies no payload bytes.

lorav:endian.description: Byte order of this multi-byte value. Byte order only; there is no byte- or word-swap mode.

lorav:multiplier.description: Factor multiplied with the raw value. Prefer lorav:divisor for decimal scaling.

lorav:divisor.description: Factor the raw value is divided by. Preferred over lorav:multiplier for decimal scaling: a divisor of 100 is exact in binary floating point, whereas the equivalent multiplier 0.01 is not.

lorav:addend.description: Constant added to the value after scaling.

lorav:bitmask.description: Hexadecimal mask selecting a contiguous range of bits.

lorav:byteOffset.description: Zero-based byte position of the value within a fixed payload layout.

lorav:byteLength.description: Byte length for variable-length wire types (string/bytes/hex/base64); -1 means consume the remaining bytes.

lorav:tag.description: Tag value(s), e.g. [channel, type], selecting this value in a tlv/ctv layout.

lorav:slot.description: 0-based order of this event within its group (multi-field TLV case, flagged group, or match case).

lorav:padBefore.description: Reserved bytes consumed (skipped) immediately before this value within its sequential group (e.g. padding inside a match case).

lorav:presentWhen.description: Condition gating whether this value appears in the payload at all.

field.description: Name of the value that decides: a flags field (used with 'bit') or a discriminator (used with 'value').

bit.description: Bit index in the flags field that must be set for this value to appear.

value.description: Discriminator value selecting the match case this value belongs to.

not.description: A value is gated either by a flag bit or by a discriminator value, never by both.

lorav:alias.description: Name under which other blocks reference this value as $alias, when a match block's name for its discriminator differs from the event name.

lorav:derived.description: Describes a value computed from other decoded values rather than read off the wire.

ref.description: Input value, a $name reference to another event.

polynomial.description: Coefficients [c0, c1, ...] evaluated as c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ... over the input value.

compute.description: Binary operation {op, a, b} over two values or constants.

guard.description: Conditional gate {when: [...], else: value} selecting a value from a predicate.

not.description: Scaling is stated once, as either a multiplier or a divisor; giving both would leave the order of the two operations undefined.

lorav:derived.description: A derived value carries no payload bytes, so its wire type must be 'number'.
